description: Whether a Texas spot is under city zoning, and for data centers, battery storage, solar and manufacturing which zoning districts allow the use outright, by special or conditional use permit, or not at all, with the code's own term for the use and a verbatim quote. Unincorporated county land has no zoning. Pro.

address.description: Texas street address, e.g. '1201 Main St, Houston, TX'. Use this or lat/lng.

lat.description: Latitude (WGS84). Use with lng instead of address.

lng.description: Longitude (WGS84). Use with lat instead of address.
